Home.h1: Ship agency and marine surveys at the Panama Canal.
Home.sub: Licensed by the Panama Maritime Authority and authorized by the Panama Canal Authority since 2010. One team for the port call. Independent surveyors for the evidence. 24/7.

credentials.acp: Authorized by the Panama Canal Authority
credentials.label: Credentials

Home.servicesTitle: What we do at both ends of the Canal
Home.servicesSub: Seven services, one accountable team for the port call, and independent surveyors for the evidence. Nominate us for the transit; the survey and the fuel are the same phone call.
Home.processTitle: How a port call works with us
Home.processSub: Four steps, each with what you receive and when.

process.title: Nomination
process.text: Send vessel particulars, ETA and the services you need. We confirm receipt with a request number and the duty officer takes it from there.

process.title: Proforma disbursement account
process.text: Canal tolls, reservation fee, fixed tariff, pilotage, tugs, linehandlers and every third-party cost itemized, with the agency fee as one line.

process.title: Boarding and transit
process.text: Our officer boards at the anchorage and coordinates the Authority, pilots, tugs, linehandlers, crew changes and supplies. One WhatsApp thread, one daily update.

process.title: Final disbursement account
process.text: Reconciled line by line against the PDA, every third-party charge with its voucher, variances explained. If a survey came up during the call, its report travels with it.

Home.portsSub: Duty officers on the Pacific and the Atlantic side, and the Panamanian ports we serve.
Home.portsNote: Send the terminal and the ETA; the duty officer confirms attendance.
Home.captainText: Captain Guillermo A. Peña brings more than 40 years of maritime experience. He holds the ISM Code Internal Auditor credential, trained at the Seafarers Training Center and Maersk Training Centre, and reviews every survey report that leaves this office.
Home.captainQuote: When you call at three in the morning, you speak with someone who has stood a bridge watch.
Home.whoSub: Different principals, different worries. Tell us who you are and we tell you how we work with you.

who.title: Shipowners & managers
who.text: Transit agency, husbandry and surveys with one accountable officer.

who.title: Charterers & traders
who.text: Bunker quantity, STS attendance and protective agency.

who.title: P&I correspondents & insurers
who.text: Condition surveys, claims attendance and evidence preserved.

who.title: Fishing fleets & regional operators
who.text: Fuel supply and agency in Spanish, on WhatsApp.

Home.proofTitle: More than 40 years at sea and in port, one desk.
Home.proofText: Cross World Agencies, S.A. has held its AMP ship agency licence and Panama Canal Authority authorization since 2010. Yacht and small-craft surveys run under our sister brand, Cross World Yacht, Marine Surveyors.
Home.reelsSub: Short clips our team publishes from surveys, deliveries and the office. Sound on.
Home.finalSub: Send the vessel particulars and ETA. You get a request number now and an itemized PDA from the duty officer.
Home.nominateHelp: Paste this block in your nomination message to the charterer or the Authority.
Home.bankNote: Bank details are issued only on the PDA and confirmed by phone with your duty officer. We never change bank details by email.

Journey.title: One transit, told from the bridge
Journey.sub: Scroll to take a vessel across the isthmus. This is what we handle at every mile.

stages.name: Balboa · Pacific anchorage
stages.title: Boarding and pre-transit
stages.text: Our officer boards at the anchorage. Pilots, documentation and the funds for tolls are confirmed before the vessel weighs anchor.

stages.name: Miraflores · Pedro Miguel
stages.title: Up through the Pacific locks
stages.text: Two lock flights lift the vessel about 26 metres to lake level, with linehandlers and locomotives working each chamber.

stages.name: Gatún Lake
stages.title: The fresh-water crossing
stages.text: A long transit across the lake. The maximum authorized draft follows the lake level; your PDA states the figure in force, with its date.
stages.tag: FRESH WATER · DRAFT BY LAKE LEVEL

stages.name: Gatún · Agua Clara
stages.title: Down to the Atlantic
stages.text: The final flight lowers the vessel to sea level. A typical transit spends 8 to 10 hours underway in Canal waters.

stages.name: Cristóbal · Atlantic
stages.title: Sailing, or the next call
stages.text: Bunker, surveys and crew changes on the Atlantic side if you need them, and an FDA reconciled line by line after departure.

Fda.metaTitle: Compare your last Panama FDA, line by line
Fda.metaDescription: Send us your last Panama Canal or port call FDA and we show you, line by line, what the same call would have cost with Cross World. No commitment.
Fda.title: Compare your last Panama FDA
Fda.lead: Send us the final disbursement account of your last Panama call. We rebuild it line by line, mark what we would have charged differently, and send it back. No commitment.
Fda.file: Your FDA (PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB)
Fda.fileHelp: Uploaded directly to private storage. Names of your current agent are kept confidential.
Fda.uploaded: File received. You can submit the form.
Fda.uploadsOff: File upload is being enabled. Submit the form and reply to the confirmation email with the FDA attached.
Fda.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Try again or reply to the confirmation email with the file.
Fda.sla: You receive the comparison by email, with no obligation.
howItems: A captain reads the FDA and checks every third-party line against the ACP tariff and the vouchers you would expect.
We rebuild the account with our agency fee as one line and mark each difference.
You get the comparison by email, with no obligation to nominate us.

Form.metaTitle: Request a port call or Canal transit
Form.metaDescription: Send vessel particulars, ETA, ports and services. You receive a request number now and an itemized PDA from the duty officer.
Form.title: Request a port call
Form.lead: Two steps: the vessel, then services and contact. You receive a request number on screen and a confirmation by email; the duty officer replies 24/7.
asideItems: You get a request number immediately and a confirmation email.
The duty officer reviews the particulars and prepares the PDA.
You receive the PDA ahead of the funds call.
Funds are called ahead of transit; the ACP requires them 48 hours before.
Form.attachmentsNote: Attachments (charter party instructions, certificates): reply to the confirmation email with the files. Direct upload is coming soon.
Form.bankNote: Bank details are issued only on the PDA and confirmed by phone with your duty officer. We never change bank details by email.

Form.etaHelp: You can update it later; we plan boarding from your ETA.
